title: ShinyHunters Extorted Boeing Spin-Off Prior to Arrests
title_zh: ShinyHunters在被捕前敲诈了波音的衍生公司

paragraphs.en: A teenager from Amman, Jordan suspected of leading the prolific data theft and extortion group ShinyHunters has been detained and is reportedly cooperating with the FBI to identify other members of the hacking gang. KrebsOnSecurity has learned that the suspect, who uses the hacker handle “ Rey ,” was detained as ShinyHunters was in the process of extorting a business unit recently divested by the global aerospace company Boeing , which manufactures the fleet of planes used by the employer of Rey’s father — Royal Jordanian Airlines .
paragraphs.zh: 一名来自约旦安曼的少年涉嫌领导多产的窃取数据和勒索组织ShinyHunters，现已被拘留，据报道他正与FBI合作，以查明这个黑客团伙的其他成员。 KrebsOnSecurity获悉，这名使用黑客代号「Rey」的嫌疑人是在ShinyHunters正勒索一家由全球航空航天公司波音最近剥离的业务部门时被拘留的，波音制造的机队正是Rey父亲雇主——约旦皇家航空——所使用的飞机。

sents.zh: 一名来自约旦安曼的少年涉嫌领导多产的窃取数据和勒索组织ShinyHunters，现已被拘留，据报道他正与FBI合作，以查明这个黑客团伙的其他成员。

paragraphs.en: The logo for Jeppesen ForeFlight, a business unit divested last year by the aerospace firm Boeing.
paragraphs.zh: Jeppesen ForeFlight 的标志，该公司是航空航天企业波音公司去年剥离的一个业务部门。

paragraphs.en: On October 3, Reuters cited three unnamed sources saying a suspected ShinyHunters member in Amman named Saif Al-din Khader was detained by Jordanian authorities and was cooperating with the FBI. KrebsOnSecurity identified Rey as Khader in a November 2025 profile , in which the young man admitted working with multiple ransomware groups.
paragraphs.zh: 10月3日，路透社援引三位不愿透露姓名的消息人士的话报道称，一名安曼的疑似 ShinyHunters 成员 Saif Al-din Khader 被约旦当局拘留，并正在与 FBI 合作。 KrebsOnSecurity 在2025年11月的一篇人物报道中确认 Rey 就是 Khader，这位年轻人在该报道中承认曾与多个勒索软件团伙合作。

sents.en: On October 3, Reuters cited three unnamed sources saying a suspected ShinyHunters member in Amman named Saif Al-din Khader was detained by Jordanian authorities and was cooperating with the FBI.
sents.zh: 10月3日，路透社援引三位不愿透露姓名的消息人士的话报道称，一名安曼的疑似 ShinyHunters 成员 Saif Al-din Khader 被约旦当局拘留，并正在与 FBI 合作。

sents.en: KrebsOnSecurity identified Rey as Khader in a November 2025 profile , in which the young man admitted working with multiple ransomware groups.
sents.zh: KrebsOnSecurity 在2025年11月的一篇人物报道中确认 Rey 就是 Khader，这位年轻人在该报道中承认曾与多个勒索软件团伙合作。

paragraphs.en: Rey was featured again in a September 28 exclusive about the Dutch police arresting 24-year-old convicted cybercriminal Pepijn van der Stap on suspicion of aiding in data thefts and extortions by ShinyHunters. The story noted that immediately following the Dutchman’s arrest on the evening of September 15, Rey assumed control over the ShinyHunters brand and boasted publicly about stealing highly sensitive data from the FBI and extorting the ransomware group Cl0p .
paragraphs.zh: 9月28日的一篇独家报道再次提到了Rey，该报道称荷兰警方逮捕了24岁的已被定罪的网络罪犯Pepijn van der Stap，罪名是涉嫌协助ShinyHunters实施数据窃取和敲诈勒索。 该报道指出，就在9月15日晚这名荷兰人被捕后不久，Rey接管了ShinyHunters的品牌，并公开吹嘘从FBI窃取了高度敏感的数据，还勒索了勒索软件团伙Cl0p。

sents.en: Rey was featured again in a September 28 exclusive about the Dutch police arresting 24-year-old convicted cybercriminal Pepijn van der Stap on suspicion of aiding in data thefts and extortions by ShinyHunters.
sents.zh: 9月28日的一篇独家报道再次提到了Rey，该报道称荷兰警方逮捕了24岁的已被定罪的网络罪犯Pepijn van der Stap，罪名是涉嫌协助ShinyHunters实施数据窃取和敲诈勒索。

sents.en: The story noted that immediately following the Dutchman’s arrest on the evening of September 15, Rey assumed control over the ShinyHunters brand and boasted publicly about stealing highly sensitive data from the FBI and extorting the ransomware group Cl0p .
sents.zh: 该报道指出，就在9月15日晚这名荷兰人被捕后不久，Rey接管了ShinyHunters的品牌，并公开吹嘘从FBI窃取了高度敏感的数据，还勒索了勒索软件团伙Cl0p。

paragraphs.en: Rey taunted both the FBI and Cl0p with memes posted to his longtime account on Twitter/X, while simultaneously including images of the avatar used by Van Der Stap’s former hacker alias “ Umbreon ” in an apparent attempt to frame the Dutchman for both hacks.
paragraphs.zh: Rey 在其长期使用的 Twitter/X 账号上发布梗图，同时嘲讽 FBI 和 Cl0p，并同时附上了 Van Der Stap 曾用黑客别名「Umbreon」所使用的头像图片，显然是企图将这两起黑客攻击嫁祸给这名荷兰人。

paragraphs.en: A taunting meme uploaded to Twitter/X by Rey on Sept. 22. A giant sized version of the Pokemon character Umbreon can be seen in the bottom left.
paragraphs.zh: Rey 于 9 月 22 日上传到 Twitter/X 的一张嘲讽表情包。 在左下角可以看到一只巨大版的宝可梦角色月亮伊布（Umbreon）。

sents.en: A taunting meme uploaded to Twitter/X by Rey on Sept. 22.
sents.zh: Rey 于 9 月 22 日上传到 Twitter/X 的一张嘲讽表情包。

sents.en: A giant sized version of the Pokemon character Umbreon can be seen in the bottom left.
sents.zh: 在左下角可以看到一只巨大版的宝可梦角色月亮伊布（Umbreon）。

paragraphs.en: As noted in our September 28 report, ShinyHunters gained access to the FBI site and other victims by exploiting a vulnerability (CVE-2026-35273) in PeopleSoft , a software-as-a-service platform from the tech giant Oracle that is broadly used by companies to manage hiring and human resources, benefits and payroll. Oracle quickly issued a fix for CVE-2026-35273, which ShinyHunters first began exploiting as a zero-day in June, and at the time Mandiant released web application firewall rules intended for organizations that couldn’t apply the security update quickly enough.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我们9月28日的报告所述，ShinyHunters利用甲骨文（Oracle）旗下软件即服务平台PeopleSoft中的一个漏洞（CVE-2026-35273）获取了对FBI网站及其他受害者的访问权限，该平台被企业广泛用于管理招聘与人力资源、福利及薪酬。 甲骨文迅速发布了针对CVE-2026-35273的修复补丁——ShinyHunters早在6月就将其作为零日漏洞加以利用——与此同时，Mandiant发布了Web应用防火墙规则，供无法及时应用该安全更新的组织使用。

sents.en: As noted in our September 28 report, ShinyHunters gained access to the FBI site and other victims by exploiting a vulnerability (CVE-2026-35273) in PeopleSoft , a software-as-a-service platform from the tech giant Oracle that is broadly used by companies to manage hiring and human resources, benefits and payroll.
sents.zh: 正如我们9月28日的报告所述，ShinyHunters利用甲骨文（Oracle）旗下软件即服务平台PeopleSoft中的一个漏洞（CVE-2026-35273）获取了对FBI网站及其他受害者的访问权限，该平台被企业广泛用于管理招聘与人力资源、福利及薪酬。

sents.en: Oracle quickly issued a fix for CVE-2026-35273, which ShinyHunters first began exploiting as a zero-day in June, and at the time Mandiant released web application firewall rules intended for organizations that couldn’t apply the security update quickly enough.
sents.zh: 甲骨文迅速发布了针对CVE-2026-35273的修复补丁——ShinyHunters早在6月就将其作为零日漏洞加以利用——与此同时，Mandiant发布了Web应用防火墙规则，供无法及时应用该安全更新的组织使用。

paragraphs.en: ShinyHunters told BleepingComputer in June that the original goal behind exploiting the PeopleSoft vulnerability was to breach the FBI’s own PeopleSoft database, but the hackers said those attacks were unsuccessful for some reason. In recent weeks, however, ShinyHunters turned to a well-known URL-encoding trick to bypass Mandiant’s suggested web application firewall rules.
paragraphs.zh: ShinyHunters 六月曾告诉 BleepingComputer，利用 PeopleSoft 漏洞的最初目标是入侵 FBI 自己的 PeopleSoft 数据库，但黑客表示这些攻击因某些原因未能成功。 然而近几周，ShinyHunters 转而使用一种众所周知的 URL 编码技巧来绕过 Mandiant 建议的 Web 应用防火墙规则。

sents.en: ShinyHunters told BleepingComputer in June that the original goal behind exploiting the PeopleSoft vulnerability was to breach the FBI’s own PeopleSoft database, but the hackers said those attacks were unsuccessful for some reason.
sents.zh: ShinyHunters 六月曾告诉 BleepingComputer，利用 PeopleSoft 漏洞的最初目标是入侵 FBI 自己的 PeopleSoft 数据库，但黑客表示这些攻击因某些原因未能成功。

sents.en: In recent weeks, however, ShinyHunters turned to a well-known URL-encoding trick to bypass Mandiant’s suggested web application firewall rules.
sents.zh: 然而近几周，ShinyHunters 转而使用一种众所周知的 URL 编码技巧来绕过 Mandiant 建议的 Web 应用防火墙规则。

paragraphs.en: In a report released Sept. 25, security experts at Mandiant and the Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) confirmed that ShinyHunters had mass-exploited the PeopleSoft vulnerability to steal data from dozens of systems across a range of industries, including higher education, technology, healthcare, agriculture, transportation and government.
paragraphs.zh: 在9月25日发布的一份报告中，Mandiant 和 Google 威胁情报集团（GTIG）的安全专家证实，ShinyHunters 曾大规模利用 PeopleSoft 漏洞，从多个行业的数十个系统中窃取数据，这些行业包括高等教育、科技、医疗保健、农业、运输和政府。

paragraphs.en: Reuters reported October 5 that the FBI has removed a contractor at Accenture over their failure to patch the FBI recruitment website hacked by ShinyHunters, which exposed sensitive data on more than 5,000 FBI personnel, including each’s person’s unit and specialization, as well as medical and psychiatric records.
paragraphs.zh: 路透社10月5日报道，联邦调查局（FBI）已解除了埃森哲（Accenture）的一名承包商，原因是其未能修复被 ShinyHunters 黑客攻击的 FBI 招聘网站。此次攻击泄露了超过5000名 FBI 人员的敏感数据，包括每人的所属单位和专业领域，以及医疗和精神病治疗记录。

paragraphs.en: According to two sources familiar with the ShinyHunters investigation, a navigation and digital aviation unit recently divested by the global aerospace company Boeing was among the victims that ShinyHunters was in the process of extorting when Rey was apprehended by Jordanian authorities.
paragraphs.zh: 据两名熟悉 ShinyHunters 调查情况的消息人士透露，全球航空航天公司波音最近出售的一个导航与数字航空部门，正是 Rey 被约旦当局逮捕时 ShinyHunters 正在实施勒索的受害者之一。

paragraphs.en: Those sources said the FBI’s investigation into ShinyHunters gained renewed urgency with the group’s attempted extortion of the former Boeing unit, which allegedly included the theft of sensitive information that sources said could pose operational safety and security risks.
paragraphs.zh: 知情人士称，FBI 对 ShinyHunters 的调查因该组织企图勒索波音前旗下部门而再度升温，据称该事件涉及窃取敏感信息，知情人士表示这些信息可能构成运营安全与安保风险。

paragraphs.en: In a brief statement shared with KrebsOnSecurity, Boeing acknowledged the extortion attempts by ShinyHunters, and said the incident concerned data stolen from Jeppesen ForeFlight , a subsidiary that Boeing sold in November 2025 to the private equity firm Thoma Bravo for $10.55 billion.
paragraphs.zh: 波音公司（Boeing）在与 KrebsOnSecurity 分享的一份简短声明中承认了 ShinyHunters 的勒索企图，并表示该事件涉及从 Jeppesen ForeFlight 窃取的数据。ForeFlight 是波音于 2025 年 11 月以 105.5 亿美元出售给私募股权公司 Thoma Bravo 的一家子公司。

paragraphs.en: “We are aware of claims by a threat actor regarding data allegedly associated with Boeing and our former subsidiary Jeppesen ForeFlight,” a Boeing spokesperson shared. “We are actively reviewing the matter with the Jeppesen ForeFlight team.”
paragraphs.zh: “我们注意到一名威胁行为者声称掌握了据称与波音及其前子公司Jeppesen ForeFlight相关的数据，”一位波音发言人表示。“我们正与Jeppesen ForeFlight团队积极审查此事。”

paragraphs.en: A spokesperson for Jeppesen ForeFlight shared a written statement in response to questions, saying the company has seen no impact on their end. “Based on our investigation to date into this claim and proactive security posture, there was no impact to our operations or products.”
paragraphs.zh: Jeppesen ForeFlight 的一位发言人在回答提问时提供了一份书面声明，表示公司方面未受到任何影响。“根据我们迄今为止对这一说法的调查以及主动的安全态势，我们的运营或产品没有受到任何影响。”

paragraphs.en: Rey’s alleged involvement in attempting to extort the former Boeing unit is noteworthy because there is strong evidence that his father works for Royal Jordanian Airlines , which is mostly controlled by the Jordanian government and operates its long-haul fleet on passenger planes built by Boeing. Rey claimed on Telegram in early 2025 that his father was an airline pilot, although that could not be independently confirmed.
paragraphs.zh: 雷据称参与企图敲诈波音前子公司一事值得关注，因为有有力证据表明他的父亲任职于约旦皇家航空，该公司主要由约旦政府控制，其远程机队运营的是波音制造的客机。 雷于2025年初在Telegram上声称他的父亲是一名航空公司飞行员，尽管这一点无法得到独立证实。

sents.zh: 雷据称参与企图敲诈波音前子公司一事值得关注，因为有有力证据表明他的父亲任职于约旦皇家航空，该公司主要由约旦政府控制，其远程机队运营的是波音制造的客机。

sents.zh: 雷于2025年初在Telegram上声称他的父亲是一名航空公司飞行员，尽管这一点无法得到独立证实。

paragraphs.en: However, as noted in our November 2025 profile of Rey , his family’s shared computer was at one point compromised by password-stealing malware, and the data collected by that malware clearly shows Rey’s father used the same credentials to log in at multiple online portals for Royal Jordanian Airlines employees.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，正如我们在2025年11月对 Rey 的简介中所指出的，他家的公用电脑曾一度被窃取密码的恶意软件入侵，该恶意软件收集的数据清楚地表明，Rey 的父亲曾使用相同的凭据登录多个约旦皇家航空（Royal Jordanian Airlines）员工在线门户。

paragraphs.en: Royal Jordanian Airlines has not yet responded to a request for comment. In advance of our September 28 story, KrebsOnSecurity once again emailed Rey’s father to seek comment and update him on his son’s alleged activities. Neither of the Khaders have responded. But just hours after that request was sent, Rey began deleting his various social media accounts, including the Twitter/X account he previously used to taunt the FBI, Cl0p, and other ShinyHunters victims.
paragraphs.zh: 皇家约旦航空尚未回应置评请求。 在我们9月28日的报道发布之前，KrebsOnSecurity再次给雷的父亲发了电子邮件，寻求置评并向他通报其儿子涉嫌活动的最新情况。 哈德父子二人都没有回应。 但就在该请求发出数小时后，雷开始删除他的各个社交媒体账号，包括他此前用来嘲讽FBI、Cl0p以及其他ShinyHunters受害者的Twitter/X账号。

sents.en: Royal Jordanian Airlines has not yet responded to a request for comment.
sents.zh: 皇家约旦航空尚未回应置评请求。

sents.en: In advance of our September 28 story, KrebsOnSecurity once again emailed Rey’s father to seek comment and update him on his son’s alleged activities.
sents.zh: 在我们9月28日的报道发布之前，KrebsOnSecurity再次给雷的父亲发了电子邮件，寻求置评并向他通报其儿子涉嫌活动的最新情况。

sents.en: But just hours after that request was sent, Rey began deleting his various social media accounts, including the Twitter/X account he previously used to taunt the FBI, Cl0p, and other ShinyHunters victims.
sents.zh: 但就在该请求发出数小时后，雷开始删除他的各个社交媒体账号，包括他此前用来嘲讽FBI、Cl0p以及其他ShinyHunters受害者的Twitter/X账号。

paragraphs.en: Rey may have nixed many of his social media profiles, but his cybersecurity blog on GitHub somehow escaped the purge, and it shows that Rey was fixated on the leaders of the Cl0p ransomware group. In March 2026, Rey’s blog featured a lengthy post that identified two Russian men as the core developers and hackers behind Cl0p.
paragraphs.zh: Rey 可能已经删除了他的许多社交媒体账号，但他在 GitHub 上的网络安全博客却不知为何躲过了这次清理，博客内容显示 Rey 一直重点关注 Cl0p 勒索软件集团的头目。 2026 年 3 月，Rey 的博客发布了一篇长文，指出两名俄罗斯男子是 Cl0p 背后的核心开发者和黑客。

sents.en: In March 2026, Rey’s blog featured a lengthy post that identified two Russian men as the core developers and hackers behind Cl0p.
sents.zh: 2026 年 3 月，Rey 的博客发布了一篇长文，指出两名俄罗斯男子是 Cl0p 背后的核心开发者和黑客。

paragraphs.en: Rey’s blog on GitHub. This post doxes two Russian men as the core operators behind Cl0p, one of the oldest and most established ransomware groups still in operation today.
paragraphs.zh: Rey 在 GitHub 上的博客。 这篇文章曝光了两名俄罗斯男子，他们是 Cl0p 背后的核心操作者——Cl0p 是至今仍在运营的历史最悠久、根基最深的勒索软件组织之一。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, news outlets in the Netherlands reported explosive new allegations leveled at Van der Stap, whose supposed personal transformation from convicted to reformed hacker has been widely covered in the tech news media. The Dutch daily RTL reported on Sept. 29 that investigators suspect Van der Stap tried to orchestrate at least two murders. According to RTL, the murders were allegedly to be committed abroad, and there are indications Van der Stap gave the order for these attacks.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，荷兰的新闻媒体报道了针对范德斯塔普（Van der Stap）的爆炸性新指控，他从被定罪的黑客到改过自新的黑客这一所谓的个人转变，曾得到科技新闻媒体的广泛报道。 荷兰每日新闻节目RTL于9月29日报道，调查人员怀疑范德斯塔普曾试图策划至少两起谋杀案。 据RTL报道，这些谋杀案据称将在国外实施，而且有迹象表明，是范德斯塔普下令发起这些袭击的。

paragraphs.en: Van der Stap was released from prison after serving the better part of a four year sentence for data theft and extortion activity that prosecutors said netted between €1.5 million and €2.7 million. In an interview with KrebsOnSecurity on September 9, Van der Stap described his new role as “offensive security lead” at the Dutch cybersecurity company Neo Security , saying the job involved probing client networks for security vulnerabilities.

paragraphs.en: Prior to his first arrest in 2023, Van der Stap was working as a software engineer at the Amsterdam-based cybersecurity startup Hadrian, while volunteering at the Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure (DIVD) — even as he was hacking into and extorting a number of large organizations.

paragraphs.en: When asked in a recent interview why anyone should believe the word of a self-described “reformed” cybercriminal who had so casually deceived countless friends, co-workers and journalists for years, Van der Stap replied that his work spoke for itself and there was nothing he could say that would convince his worst critics.
paragraphs.zh: 当在最近的一次采访中被问及，为什么有人应该相信一个自称为“改邪归正”的网络罪犯的话——此人多年来如此轻易地欺骗了无数朋友、同事和记者——范德斯塔普回答说，他的作品本身就足以说明问题，无论他说什么都无法说服那些最严厉的批评者。

paragraphs.en: “You can throw a bunch of nice words at someone, but you can’t convince them if they don’t want to be convinced,” Van der Stap told KrebsOnSecurity on Sept. 9. “I’m doing what I can to repay victims, and that’s all I can do. If someone doesn’t want to believe me, then that’s on them.”

paragraphs.en: Cybercriminals aligned with ShinyHunters have been responsible for dozens of data breaches involving billions of stolen records, and breaches claimed by the group stretch back to at least 2019. But experts say the people recently operating behind the ShinyHunters name are not the same core members that populated the group in its early days, most of whom are French citizens who have been arrested (if not also imprisoned) on at least one prior occasion for alleged cybercrime activity.
paragraphs.zh: 与ShinyHunters结盟的网络犯罪分子已对数十起涉及数十亿条被盗记录的数据泄露事件负责，而该组织声称实施的泄露事件最早可追溯到2019年。 但专家表示，最近以ShinyHunters名义活动的人并非该组织早期那些核心成员，其中大多数人都是法国公民，此前至少有一次因涉嫌网络犯罪活动而被捕（甚至入狱）。

paragraphs.en: More to the point, ShinyHunters has become something of a franchise. Think the Dread Pirate Roberts character in the 1980s cult movie classic “The Princess Bride,” only succession by death is replaced with succession by arrest, and there can be multiple simultaneous Dread Pirate Robertses. Sources close to the investigation say the FBI is focusing on a remaining handful of cybercriminal freelancers or affiliates who have been feeding the group stolen credentials to various software-as-a-service (SaaS) platforms used by major companies in exchange for a cut of any data ransoms later paid by victims.
paragraphs.zh: 更确切地说，ShinyHunters 已经成为一种类似“特许经营”的存在。 可以把它想象成上世纪八十年代经典邪典电影《公主新娘》中的“恐怖海盗罗伯茨”这一角色，只不过那里靠死亡来传承，这里是靠被捕来传承，而且可以同时存在多个“恐怖海盗罗伯茨”。 接近调查的消息人士称，联邦调查局（FBI）目前正聚焦于剩余的少数几名网络犯罪自由职业者或附属成员，这些人向该组织提供各大公司所用各类软件即服务（SaaS）平台的被盗凭据，以换取受害者日后所付数据赎金的一部分分成。

Several commentators accused Rey of resurrecting the ShinyHunters brand after its core members were rounded up in France, and making a mockery of the group’s name and reputation ever since.

paragraphs.en: “He bought the old forum PGP key and used it to make new Breachforum websites and Telegram channels larping as ShinyHunters to ransom companies and then sell the used data or resell his forum when he goes broke,” one member recounted.
paragraphs.zh: “他买下了那个旧论坛的 PGP 密钥，并用它创建了新的 Breachforum 网站和 Telegram 频道，假扮成 ShinyHunters 向公司勒索，然后在数据被用过之后卖掉数据，或者在他破产时把论坛转卖出去，”一名成员回忆道。

paragraphs.en: A relatively new Telegram channel called “The Battle” has been doxing and needling Rey and other alleged ShinyHunters members for several weeks, and it has gained a considerable readership among the cybercrime communities operating on Telegram. One of the coordinators of that harassment campaign repeatedly portrayed Rey as clueless greenhorn who sought to ride the coattails of a cybercriminal brand that has long enjoyed a reputation for ruthlessly selling or publishing data stolen from victim companies who refuse to give in to extortion demands.
paragraphs.zh: 一个名为「The Battle」的相对较新的 Telegram 频道已经对 Rey 和其他据称是 ShinyHunters 成员的人进行了数周的「人肉」和挑衅，并在 Telegram 上活动的网络犯罪社区中获得了相当可观的读者群。 这场骚扰行动的一名协调者多次把 Rey 描绘成一个不懂行的菜鸟，试图借一个网络犯罪品牌的名声上位，该品牌长期以来以无情地出售或公开发布拒绝屈服于勒索要求的受害公司被盗数据而闻名。

We’re aware of claims that [Rey] caused over $200 million in damages and helped around 5–6 friend groups in the community make money by using Shiny Hunters group aliases to negotiate deals for a 25–30% cut over the past few months.”
paragraphs.zh: “Rey（Saif Al-Din Khader）在开始冒充 ShinyHunters 成员时犯了一个严重错误，”The Battle 服务器的管理员在 Telegram 上写道。“该组织早已被瓦解，许多成员或被捕或入狱，然而 Rey 在实施犯罪时仍然选择使用它的名义。 我们注意到有说法称 [Rey] 造成了超过 2 亿美元的损失，并在过去几个月里利用 Shiny Hunters 组织的化名帮助社区中大约 5–6 个朋友圈谈判交易并从中抽取 25–30% 的分成来获利。”

paragraphs.en: In an interview with The Register , ShinyHunters claimed they hacked the FBI to counter the agency’s narrative in a May 2026 alert that advised victims against paying a ransom to the group, which came off looking unprofessional and capricious in the FBI’s advisory.
paragraphs.zh: 在接受《The Register》采访时，ShinyHunters 声称他们入侵了 FBI，是为了反驳该机构在 2026 年 5 月发布的一份警报中的说法——该警报建议受害者不要向该组织支付赎金，而在这份 FBI 通告中，该组织显得既不专业又反复无常。

paragraphs.en: A flash notice on ShinyHunters released by the FBI on May 15, 2026.
paragraphs.zh: FBI 于2026年5月15日发布的关于 ShinyHunters 的快讯。

paragraphs.en: The public notice warned the group has been known to pursue a number of different victim harassment strategies , from sending threatening text messages and phone calls to victims and their family members to in some cases swatting victims. The FBI warned ShinyHunters members “may also falsely claim to have sensitive or compromising information, including embarrassing photographs or videos of victims, which frequently do not exist.”
paragraphs.zh: 该公告警告称，该团伙已知会采取多种不同的受害者骚扰策略，从向受害者及其家人发送威胁短信和打电话，到在某些情况下对受害者实施虚假报警（swatting）。 联邦调查局警告称，ShinyHunters 成员“还可能虚假声称掌握敏感或具有要挟性的信息，包括受害者的不雅照片或视频，而这些信息通常并不存在。”

paragraphs.en: The hackers told The Register their attack on the FBI “demonstrated our technical capabilities and directly refuted the misinformation disseminated by the FBI, journalists, and industry researchers.” At the same time, the group’s leaders seemed to acknowledge that the FBI’s warning materially harmed their prospects for convincing victims to pay, saying “this was fundamentally a public relations and marketing initiative for our business.”
paragraphs.zh: 黑客们告诉 The Register，他们对 FBI 的攻击“展示了我们的技术能力，并直接驳斥了 FBI、记者和行业研究人员散布的错误信息。”与此同时，该组织的头目似乎也承认，FBI 的警告严重损害了他们说服受害者付款的前景，并表示“这从根本上是我们业务的一次公关和营销行动。”

paragraphs.en: We know for sure that 15-year-old Saif Al-din Khader is affiliated with ShinyHunters, but we should be cautious about concluding he is definitely Rey / Hikki-chan, i.e one of the three core figures behind SHLH.
paragraphs.zh: 我们确知15岁的 Saif Al-din Khader 隶属于 ShinyHunters，但在断定他一定就是 Rey / Hikki-chan（即 SHLH 背后的三位核心人物之一）时应保持谨慎。

paragraphs.en: Rey asked to be contacted via @wristmug, which is the account that was de-anonymised. paragraphs.en: The part of this story that should worry defenders most is the access path, not the arrests. ShinyHunters mass-exploited a PeopleSoft vulnerability for which Mandiant had already published WAF mitigations — and bypassed them with a URL-encoding trick. That’s a published mitigation that organizations simply didn’t implement, and it ended up exposing the FBI’s own recruitment data plus 70 organizations. It undercuts the common excuse that “we couldn’t have known.” The gap wasn’t threat intelligence, it was execution.
paragraphs.zh: 这个故事中最应该让防御者担心的部分是访问路径，而不是抓捕行动。 ShinyHunters 大规模利用了一个 PeopleSoft 漏洞，而 Mandiant 早已发布了针对该漏洞的 WAF 缓解措施——攻击者却用一个 URL 编码技巧绕过了它们。 那是一条早已公开的缓解措施，只是各组织根本没有落实，结果导致 FBI 自己的招聘数据以及 70 个组织的数据被泄露。 这削弱了「我们当时不可能知道」这一常见的借口。差距不在于威胁情报，而在于执行。

paragraphs.en: The franchise point resonates too. Arresting one teenager and watching the darknet site go offline looks like a win, but the brand just fragments into Telegram channels arguing over who the “real” ShinyHunters is. The Dread Pirate Roberts comparison is apt — succession doesn’t require anyone’s permission. Until the underlying access-broker pipeline (initial access via unpatched enterprise apps) is fixed, another Rey will pick up the brand.
paragraphs.zh: 关于“品牌继承者”的观点也很能引起共鸣。 逮捕一名少年并看着暗网网站下线看似是一场胜利，但这个品牌只会分裂成几个争论谁是“真正的”ShinyHunters 的 Telegram 频道。 用“恐惧海盗罗伯茨”作类比很贴切——继任不需要任何人的许可。 只要底层的初始访问经纪人管道（通过未打补丁的企业应用实现初始访问）未被修复，就会有另一个 Rey 接过这个品牌。
